description: Create the GitHub Actions workflow for daily subscription expiration alerts via Discord/Telegram webhook
steps: Create directory .github/workflows/ if it does not exist
Configure triggers: schedule with cron '0 9 * * *' (daily at 9:00 AM UTC) and workflow_dispatch for manual triggering
Define a single job 'check-expirations' running on ubuntu-latest
Steps: 1) actions/checkout@v4 to get repo contents, 2) actions/setup-node@v4 with node-version 20, 3) Run inline Node.js script

The inline Node.js script should: read database.json from the filesystem using fs.readFileSync, parse JSON, filter for records where status is 'Active' AND endDate minus today equals exactly 2 days (48 hours), if any found send a formatted Discord webhook POST to the NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK secret URL

The Discord webhook payload should include an embed with: title 'Subscription Expiration Alert', color (orange/warning), description listing each expiring client's email and end date, and a footer with the current date
Use the secrets.NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK environment variable (env: WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK }})
Add error handling: if database.json is empty or no expirations found, log a message and exit cleanly without sending a webhook
acceptance_criteria: Workflow triggers on schedule cron '0 9 * * *' and workflow_dispatch
Workflow checks out repo and runs Node.js script
Script reads database.json and filters for subscriptions expiring in exactly 2 days
Script sends Discord-formatted webhook POST with expiring client details
Script uses NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK secret via environment variable
Script handles edge cases (empty database, no expirations) gracefully
verification: Run: python3 -c "import yaml; y=yaml.safe_load(open('/projects/sandbox/chatgpt-checkout-launcher/.github/workflows/alerts.yml')); assert 'schedule' in y[True] or 'schedule' in y.get('on',{}); print('Valid YAML with schedule trigger')" || python3 -c "data=open('/projects/sandbox/chatgpt-checkout-launcher/.github/workflows/alerts.yml').read(); assert 'cron' in data; assert '0 9 * * *' in data; assert 'NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK' in data; assert 'database.json' in data; assert 'workflow_dispatch' in data; print('All workflow checks pass')"

Run: python3 -c "data=open('/projects/sandbox/chatgpt-checkout-launcher/.github/workflows/alerts.yml').read(); assert 'checkout' in data; assert 'node' in data.lower() or 'setup-node' in data; assert 'Active' in data; print('Workflow structure checks pass')"
findings: Workflow created and validated. YAML is valid, contains all required triggers, references database.json, filters Active records expiring in exactly 2 days, sends Discord webhook with embeds payload.
